tha-ap452:1.1: Bodhighariya.] Siddhatthassa bhagavato dipadindassa tādino / pasannacitto sumano bodhigharam akārayiṃ. // //
tha-ap452:2.1: Tusitaṃ upapanno 'mhi vasāmi ratane ghare / na me sītaṃ vā uṇhaṃ vā vāto gatte na samphuse. // //
tha-ap452:3.1: Pañcasaṭṭhimh' ito kappe cakkavattī ahos' ahaṃ / Kāsikaṃ nāma nagaraṃ Vissakammena māpitaṃ // //
tha-ap452:4.1: dasayojana-āyāmaṃ aṭṭhayojana-vitthataṃ / na tamhi nagare atthi kaṭṭhaṃ vallī ca mattikā. // //
tha-ap452:5.1: Tiriyaṃ yojanaṃ āsi addhayojana-vitthataṃ / Maṅgalo nāma pāsādo Vissakammena māpito. // //
tha-ap452:6.1: Cullāsītisahassāni thambhā sovaṇṇayā ahuṃ / maṇimayā ca niyyuhā chadanaṃ rūpiyaṃ ahū. // //
tha-ap452:7.1: Sabbasovaṇṇayaṃ gharaṃ Vissakammena māpitaṃ / ajjhāvutthaṃ mayā etaṃ gharadānass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap452:8.1: Te sabbe anubhotvāna devamānusake bhave / ajja patto 'mhi nibbānaṃ santipadam anuttaraṃ. // //
tha-ap452:9.1: Catunavute ito kappe bodhigharam akārayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi gharadānass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap452:13.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Bodhighariyo thero i. g. a-ti.
tha-ap452:17.1: Vibhītakī Kolaphalī Billa-Bhallāṭaka-ppadā Nigrodh' Ambāṭakī c' eva Āsanī Pādapīṭhako
tha-ap452:18.1: Vediko Bodhighariko gāthāyo gaṇitā-v-iha ekūnāsītikā sabbā asmiṃ vagge pakittitā.
